channel.title: Mauritania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritania, every source cited.

item.title: Mauritania launches local development program consultations
item.description: Minister of Agriculture reviews phase two of an emergency local development plan in the Brakna region.

item.title: Mauritania finds new study options for excluded medical students
item.description: The ministry is offering alternative countries for Mauritanian students denied specialization spots in Algeria.

item.title: Somelec cuts power in Nouakchott for maintenance
item.description: Temporary electricity outages will affect five Nouakchott districts between October 30 and November 1, 2026.

item.title: Mauritania health ministry prepares new clinics
item.description: Health Minister Naha Hamdi Mouknass reviewed preparations for opening new health centers in Nouakchott.

item.title: Mauritania seeks biodiversity funding in Armenia
item.description: Environment Minister Massouda Baham Mohamed Lagdaf met UN officials to discuss financing for conservation projects.
